name: How is heating and cooling handled for a new bonus room addition?
description: HVAC needs are met by extending your central ductwork if system capacity allows, or by installing an independent ductless mini-split unit.

mainEntity.name: How is heating and cooling handled for a new bonus room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most bonus room additions require upgrading or expanding your climate control to maintain comfortable humidity and temperatures. Tying the new space into your existing central system depends on whether your current air handler has sufficient duct capacity and tonnage to support additional cubic feet. If your current unit cannot handle the extra load without straining, installing a ductless mini-split provides dedicated climate control specifically for the bonus area. Addressing this during the framing and electrical rough-in stages ensures consistent indoor comfort and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: HVAC needs are met by extending your central ductwork if system capacity allows, or by installing an independent ductless mini-split unit.
